page.overview:
Who is Moore?

Admiral Moore was a 24th century Starfleet flag officer stationed at Starbase 73.

In 2365, Moore met with Captain Picard to discuss a recently discovered SOS call located in the Ficus sector. Moore subsequently ordered the to conduct a mission to investigate the mysterious call. ()
